verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the power-board orientation, USB-C edge placement, and four-corner mounting-hole layout.
The client adds concrete PCB-envelope constraints: minimum practical size, M2.5 mounting holes, and an approximately 2:1 non-square aspect ratio.
The client changes the mechanical fit requirement so the power board must fit vertically in the base; replacing the existing orientation key leaves no stale attribute.
The client requires the connector arrangement to preserve access and clearance around the mounting holes.
The client tentatively proposes a separate future single-board project and asks for feedback; the source does not clearly remove the existing power-board form-factor requirement.
